name: chart
title: Chart
description: Recharts v3 composed with Eskais tokens: ChartContainer maps a config to --color-<key> variables (light and dark), popover tooltips and legends, and ChartDataTable renders the same data as a table for screen readers and agents. The container is a figure that requires a name.
docs: Categorical series use --chart-1 to --chart-5. Series with a meaning use the series tokens, which follow the theme and meet 3:1 on the background and card in both modes: --series-positive (gains, done; from --success), --series-negative (losses, failures; from --destructive), --series-target (a goal or reference line; from --foreground) and --series-remaining (what is left, a track; from --muted-foreground over --muted). Pass them as a config color, e.g. { done: { label: "Done", color: "var(--series-positive)" } }, or use the Tailwind colours (stroke-series-target). Don't rely on colour alone: add a legend or labels, and dash a target line. `ChartDataTable data labelKey keys` is generic over the row type (`TRow extends object`), so rows typed by an `interface` pass as they are and `labelKey` and `keys` must name their fields.
